_comment: Building blocks: the prepositions, connectors and time/place/quantity words that hold sentences together. Merged by vocab_pipeline.build_dataset into the seed with the hidden `building-blocks` tag; JamView mixes a couple into every daily set. An entry with only `lemma` (plus optional `partOfSpeech` / `cefrLevel`) tags a word the seed already ships — those two fields override the shipped value, nothing else about it changes. Any other entry is a new word and needs every field. File order is teaching priority within a CEFR band for new words.

entries.example: Sono di Roma, ma vivo a Milano.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm from Rome, but I live in Milan.

entries.example: Domani vado a Napoli con mia sorella.
entries.exampleEnglish: Tomorrow I'm going to Naples with my sister.

entries.example: Vivo qui da tre anni.
entries.exampleEnglish: I've lived here for three years.

entries.example: Vado in ufficio in bicicletta.
entries.exampleEnglish: I go to the office by bike.

entries.example: Stasera esco con i miei amici.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going out with my friends tonight.

entries.example: Questo regalo è per te.
entries.exampleEnglish: This present is for you.

entries.example: Ho letto un libro su Leonardo da Vinci.
entries.exampleEnglish: I read a book about Leonardo da Vinci.

entries.example: Ho un fratello e una sorella.
entries.exampleEnglish: I have a brother and a sister.

entries.example: È caro, ma è molto buono.
entries.exampleEnglish: It's expensive, but it's very good.

entries.example: Preferisci il tè o il caffè?
entries.exampleEnglish: Do you prefer tea or coffee?

entries.example: Penso che tu abbia ragione.
entries.exampleEnglish: I think that you're right.

entries.example: Se hai tempo stasera, chiamami.
entries.exampleEnglish: If you've got time tonight, call me.

entries.example: Prendo un caffè senza zucchero, grazie.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'll have a coffee without sugar, thanks.

entries.example: C'è un supermercato vicino a casa mia.
entries.exampleEnglish: There's a supermarket near my house.

entries.example: A volte pranzo in ufficio con i colleghi.
entries.exampleEnglish: Sometimes I have lunch at the office with my colleagues.

entries.example: Scusa, puoi dirlo di nuovo?
entries.exampleEnglish: Sorry, can you say it again?

entries.example: Chi viene alla festa stasera?
entries.exampleEnglish: Who's coming to the party tonight?

entries.example: Che cosa fai questo fine settimana?
entries.exampleEnglish: What are you doing this weekend?

entries.example: Il treno parte tra dieci minuti.
entries.exampleEnglish: The train leaves in ten minutes.

entries.example: Camminiamo verso la stazione.
entries.exampleEnglish: Let's walk towards the station.

entries.example: Esco lo stesso, anche se piove.
entries.exampleEnglish: I'm going out anyway, even if it rains.

entries.example: Il bar è di fronte a casa mia.
entries.exampleEnglish: The café is opposite my house.

entries.example: Secondo me, questo film è troppo lungo.
entries.exampleEnglish: In my opinion, this film is too long.

entries.example: Il volo è in ritardo a causa di uno sciopero.
entries.exampleEnglish: The flight is delayed because of a strike.

entries.example: Non è mia sorella, bensì mia cugina.
entries.exampleEnglish: She isn't my sister but my cousin.
